# Knot Atlas

Interactive 3D guide to tying knots.

## Knots

- [Overhand Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/overhand-knot/): The simplest knot there is, and the first move of many others
- [Figure-Eight Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/figure-eight-knot/): The standard stopper
- [Square Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/square-knot/): A flat binding knot for tying the two ends of one cord round something: a parcel, a bandage, a reefed sail
- [Clove Hitch](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/clove-hitch/): Two turns round a post with the second crossing over the first
- [Constrictor Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/constrictor-knot/): A clove hitch with an extra tuck, which locks the two ends under the crossing turn
- [Sheet Bend](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/sheet-bend/): The everyday knot for joining two ropes, including ropes of different thickness
- [Double Fisherman’s Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/double-fishermans-knot/): Each rope ties a double overhand round the other
- [Rolling Hitch](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/rolling-hitch/): A hitch that holds against a pull along a pole or another rope, not just across it
- [Round Turn and Two Half Hitches](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/round-turn-two-half-hitches/): A round turn on a ring or post takes the load while you finish with two half hitches round the standing part
- [Prusik Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/prusik-knot/): A loop of thinner cord wrapped round a rope
- [Bowline](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/bowline/): The classic fixed loop
- [Figure-Eight Loop](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/figure-eight-loop/): A Figure-Eight Knot tied in a doubled rope
- [Slipped Overhand Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/slipped-overhand-knot/): An overhand knot finished with a bight instead of the end, so one pull on the short end releases it
- [Double Overhand Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/double-overhand-knot/): An overhand knot with one extra turn
- [Multiple Overhand Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/multiple-overhand-knot/): An overhand knot with four or more turns
- [Slipped Figure-Eight Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/slipped-figure-eight-knot/): A figure-eight finished with a bight, so a pull on the short end releases it
- [Stevedore Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/stevedore-knot/): A figure-eight with one more turn round the standing part
- [Granny Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/granny-knot/): The square knot tied wrong: both halves twisted the same way
- [Thief Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/thief-knot/): It looks almost exactly like a square knot, but the two short ends come out diagonally opposite each other
- [Slipped Square Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/slipped-square-knot/): A square knot with one end pulled through as a bight
- [Bow Knot](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/bow-knot/): The knot on your shoes: a square knot with both ends slipped
- [Overhand Loop](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/overhand-loop/): An overhand knot tied in a doubled rope
- [Threaded Figure-Eight Loop](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/threaded-figure-eight-loop/): The Figure-Eight Loop tied round something you cannot drop a loop over, such as a harness, a tree or a ring: tie a single figure-eight, pass the end round, and trace it back through the knot.
- [Englishman’s Loop](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/englishmans-loop/): A fixed loop made of two overhand knots, one in the end round the standing part and one in the standing part round the end
- [Double Englishman’s Loop](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/double-englishmans-loop/): The Englishman’s Loop tied with double overhands
- [Double Overhand Noose](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/double-overhand-noose/): A running loop held by a double overhand tied round the standing part
- [Cow Hitch](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/cow-hitch/): A bight of rope dropped round a rail with both legs pulled through it
- [Round Turn Bowline](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/knots/round-turn-bowline/): A bowline with the small loop taken twice round
